description: The finished transcript. json gives segments with word timings and speakers (what the app shows); txt, srt and vtt give the file the app's Export menu makes. A long recording is a lot of text: pass from and to (seconds) for only the paragraphs around a moment, such as a match from search_transcriptions, or summaryOnly for the summary instead. Not ready yet answers with the not_ready error; check get_transcription first.

from.description: Seconds into the recording where the stretch to read starts. Paragraphs overlapping it come back whole.

summaryOnly.description: true: the summary instead of the transcript, as get_summary returns it. Leave format, from and to out with it: they are not used.

timestamps.description: txt: include the time of each paragraph.

to.description: Seconds into the recording where it ends.

name: get_transcript
title: Read a transcript
